messages.author: 8d587ec0858ae795
messages.subject: Problem with R chunk in Rmd fle
parts:
Problems running this R chunk inside Rmd file(RStudio):

```{r echo =FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
dat <- read.csv("dataSets/EconomistData.csv")
pc1 <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = CPI, y = HDI, color = Region))
  (pc1 <- pc1 + geom_point(shape = 1))


label.these <- c("Congo", "Sudan", "Afghanistan", "Greece", "China",
                 "India", "Rwanda", "Spain", "France", "United States",
                 "Japan", "Norway", "Singapore")
(pc2 <- pc1 +
 geom_text(aes(label = Country),
           color = "black", size = 3, hjust = 1.1,
           data = dat[dat$Country %in% label.these, ]))

  (pc3 <- pc2 +
   geom_smooth(aes(group = 1),
               method = "lm",
               color = "black",
               formula = y~ poly(x, 2),
               se = FALSE))

(pc4 <- pc3 + theme_bw() +
  scale_x_continuous("Corruption Perceptions Index, 2011\n(10 = least corrupt)") +
  scale_y_continuous("Human Development Index, 2011\n(1 = best)") +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.direction = "horizontal"))

```

All the times I try to run I get :

Error in file(file, "rt") : cannot open the connection
Calls: <Anonymous> ... withVisible -> eval -> eval -> read.csv -> read.table -> file
Execution halted


What can I do?

Regards
